subtitle: Lightweight Modern Server Panel
rt_store_desc: Select only the web servers, databases, and language runtimes you need and install them in one click.
port_help_proxy: 💡 What is App Port? Unlike PHP, Rust/Python/Node.js/Java apps listen on an internal port number, and Nginx connects your domain to it. Enter your app's listening port (e.g., Node.js 3000, Django 8000, Rust/Spring Boot 8080).
tip_ssl: Automatically issue free Let's Encrypt HTTPS SSL certificate
tip_ftp: Automatically create dedicated FTP/SFTP account for file uploads
tip_db: Automatically create MariaDB/MySQL database and user
site_uncheck_warn: ⚠️ Unchecked options (FTP/SFTP, DB) will NOT be created. To install boards/CMS (CBoard, Gnuboard, WordPress, etc.), make sure to check 'Auto Create DB'! (Leaving ID/PW blank auto-generates 'domain_ftp' / 'domain_db' with random passwords.)
site_wizard_hint: 💡 Both custom domains (aaa.com) and subdomains (sub.chost.work) can be provisioned with Language, Framework, SSL, FTP/SFTP, and DB at once.
app_port_guide: 💡 What is App Port? It is the internal port your app listens on. Use the same port number you entered when creating the site.
setup_modal_desc: Before creating domains, choose the web server, database, and language runtimes to install in one click. (You can install more later in Runtime Store.)
ph_db_sql: SQL Query (e.g. SELECT * FROM sites LIMIT 20;)
guide_db_studio:
💡 Quick Guide: Inspect and back up databases safely without phpMyAdmin.
• MariaDB: Select a site database to view tables, run SQL, or download a .sql dump.
• SQLite: Enter a .db path on the server (e.g. /var/lib/chost/chost.db).
guide_storage:
💡 Quick Guide: Keep disk usage clean without risking important data.
1) Click [Preview Scan] first to inspect old log files.
2) Click [Safe Clean] to compress old .log files and remove .gz/.tmp. (Databases and uploads are strictly protected)
guide_file_editor: 💡 Quick Guide: Click any folder or file in the browser below to open and edit it without typing long paths.
guide_web_term: 💡 Quick Guide: Run single server check commands directly from your browser or use the quick buttons below.
guide_sec_pw: 💡 Note: Change your CHost panel login password here.
guide_sec_reset: 💡 Note: Reset the panel for clean testing. Soft Reset only resets panel lists and setup wizard; Full Reset removes all created sites, FTP, DBs, and web files.
opt_reset_soft: Soft Reset (Reset panel lists & setup wizard only)
opt_reset_full: Full Reset (Permanently delete all sites, FTP, DBs & web folders)
ph_git_url: Auto-install from Git URL (optional) e.g. https://github.com/user/repo.git
sc_git_help: 💡 Sites installed from a Git URL can be updated to the latest source here. The app is rebuilt and restarted automatically, and visitors see a 'starting' page meanwhile.
sc_git_none: This site was not installed from Git. (Enter a Git URL when creating a new site to use this.)
